nodes.label: MFA-Aware Route Gate Rationale
nodes.rationale: Owner and Admin roles require aal2 (MFA verified) to access any protected route. Viewer is exempt because MFA is optional for read-only roles. AUTH_ROUTES (/login, /forgot-password, /reset-password, /accept-invite, /mfa) are always reachable even at aal1 to prevent redirect loops where the middleware redirects to /mfa but /mfa itself is blocked.

nodes.label: No-Public-Signup Invariant
nodes.rationale: CabbyBot is admin-provisioned only (DISABLE_SIGNUP=true). The no-signup invariant is enforced structurally: both auth-structure.test and marketing-structure.test scan all files under src/app and assert that no file path matches /(signup|sign-up|register)/i. This catches accidental route additions at CI time rather than relying on runtime config alone.

nodes.label: parseClaims — Shared JWT→Claims Parser
nodes.rationale: parseClaims is the single canonical function that maps a raw JWT payload (Record<string,unknown>) to the typed Claims shape. It is intentionally pure and side-effect free so it can be called both inside the Next.js edge middleware (for routing decisions) and inside server-side session helpers (getCurrentClaims). This avoids duplicating JWT field extraction logic and ensures the Claims type is always authoritative.

nodes.label: Migration 0007: automations build-queue pipeline fields
nodes.rationale: Pipeline stage (build_stage) is separate from runtime status to allow the build Kanban to track provisioning without conflating with live health.

nodes.label: automations.build_stage column (Requested|Scoped|Building|UAT|Live)
nodes.rationale: Kanban pipeline stage distinct from runtime automations.status (building|uat|live|stopped|error).

nodes.label: Migration 0009: tenants.contact_email column
nodes.rationale: Nullable so existing rows provisioned before this column remain valid. Used for onboarding and invite delivery (Epic 3 Task 4 Send Invite).

nodes.label: Migration 0010: vault RPC wrapper functions
nodes.rationale: PostgREST runs every request on its own pooled connection so a separate set_config call cannot share a session. Wrappers accept the key as a parameter and set_config transaction-locally inside the same function body, ensuring the inner vault function sees the key in one PostgREST call = one transaction.

nodes.label: vault_store_credential_rpc function (SECURITY INVOKER)
nodes.rationale: Wraps vault_store_credential to accept encryption key as parameter; sets it transaction-locally before delegating. REVOKE from PUBLIC/anon/authenticated is the real caller gate.

nodes.label: vault_read_credential_rpc function (SECURITY INVOKER)
nodes.rationale: Reads encrypted credential by setting key transaction-locally via set_config before calling inner SECURITY DEFINER vault_read_credential.

nodes.label: vault_rotate_credential_rpc function (SECURITY DEFINER)
nodes.rationale: Re-encrypts an existing credential row in-place using pgp_sym_encrypt. current_user guard + REVOKE are the dual access controls.

nodes.label: vault RPC REVOKE EXECUTE from PUBLIC/anon/authenticated
nodes.rationale: The REVOKE is the actual caller gate; the inner current_user check runs as the function owner (postgres) and does NOT screen the wrapper caller. Only service_role/postgres/supabase_admin retain EXECUTE.
nodes.norm_label: vault rpc revoke execute from public/anon/authenticated

nodes.label: Migration 0011: audit_log append-only trigger
nodes.rationale: service_role bypasses RLS and could still UPDATE/DELETE rows, making the documented append-only guarantee unenforceable without a trigger. Trigger fires regardless of role/RLS-bypass, blocking ALL UPDATE/DELETE including service_role.

nodes.label: prevent_audit_log_mutation() trigger function
nodes.rationale: Raises exception on any UPDATE/DELETE on audit_log. INSERT still allowed. SELECT governed by existing RLS from migration 0005.

nodes.label: audit_log_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE trigger
nodes.norm_label: audit_log_immutable before update or delete trigger

nodes.label: Migration 0012: automations.engine_webhook_url column
nodes.rationale: Internal n8n webhook URL the edge gateway forwards channel events to. Nullable because automations in Requested/Scoped build stage have no engine webhook yet. Never surfaced to tenants.

nodes.label: env.SUPABASE_VAULT_KEY — channel-credentials vault symmetric key
nodes.rationale: Passed per-call to vault_*_rpc functions which set it transaction-locally before delegating to pgcrypto. Never logged, never returned to client. Local-dev default keeps supabase start + tests working without extra setup.

nodes.label: env.N8N_BASE_URL / env.N8N_API_KEY (optional)
nodes.rationale: Internal only; never exposed to customers. Optional so build/typecheck without infra still passes; gateway/engine modules throw a clear error at call time if missing.

nodes.label: env.CHANNEL_CACHE_TTL_SEC (default 300)
nodes.rationale: Channel-to-automation resolver Redis cache TTL matching PRD §7 5-min target.

nodes.label: env.IDEMPOTENCY_TTL_SEC (default 86400)
nodes.rationale: Inbound message dedupe window — 24 hours prevents double-processing replayed provider webhooks.
